title: P0 fix logic and test suite are well-designed and should be defended
description: The > vs >= change is the minimal correct fix. The comment explaining WHY we must process the line at exactly max is essential — a future contributor will see '>=' in a limit-check pattern elsewhere and 'simplify' it back to >=. The 5 new decode_limited tests directly encode the specification and all use an independent oracle (Python binascii). The zero-limit and over-limit tests are correctness guardrails that would have caught the original P0 bug if they'd existed. Keep all 5 tests.
close_reason: Design decision stands: > fix and 5 tests are correct and correct design.
